title: Bitcoin cleared the door; $86k still needs a close
dek: Coinbase price, Farside ETF flows, and OKX positioning through 22 September 2026.
thesis: Bitcoin cleared $81.5k and reached $87k, but $86k support is not confirmed.
stakes: ETF inflows supported the move; short liquidations and rising leverage supplied torque. The next fact is the completed daily close.
subscribeHook: When $86k holds — or the break fails below $81.5k — the letter hits your inbox the same day. Charts stay free here; the call moves by email.
sourceNote: The issue’s three publication charts use Coinbase Exchange UTC candles, Farside Investors US-session ETF flows, and OKX public BTC-USDT perpetual open-interest/funding data. The issue labels the date range, timezone, units, retrieval time, and missing ETF observations. Educational scenario research; no leverage.

briefs.headline: The price path: $77k to $87k
briefs.lede: One completed close above $81.5k is printed; the $86k support test remains open.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. Coinbase’s 18 September high reached $81,388; the 21 September daily closed at $86,595 after reaching $87,397. The 22 September candle was open at retrieval.

Read. A level crossed is not a level held. The desk is watching the close, not a higher target.

briefs.headline: ETF flows turned supportive
briefs.lede: The flow tape helped the break, but the positive run is short and includes one outsized session.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. Farside reported −$450.4M and −$295.9M on 15–16 September, then +$159.5M, +$433.0M, and +$999.0M on 17–18 and 21 September.

Read. Supportive is observable. Persistent is not yet earned.

briefs.headline: Positioning rose with the rally
briefs.lede: OKX OI rose into the break and funding stayed positive; the move had leverage in it.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. OKX BTC-USDT perpetual OI rose from $2.14B on 15 September to $2.66B on 20 September. Average realized funding reached 0.0100% per eight hours on 19 September.

Read. A short-liquidation spark plus new leverage is a stronger explanation than spot demand alone. The values are venue-specific.
